policies.title: Salvadoran ordinary passports: Grenada short-visitor visa exemption
policies.summary: Grenada's live Embassy-linked nationality schedule lists El Salvador as not requiring a visa.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Salvadoran passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Grenada's active Embassy schedule is marked updated April 2024; recheck if the Embassy publishes a replacement.
Work, study, residence, transit, crew, diplomatic, official, service, special-document and final-admission treatment are outside scope.

policies.title: Salvadoran ordinary passports: Panama short-visitor visa exemption
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy nationality list explicitly includes El Salvador in its no-visa cohort.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Salvadoran passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Panama's page gives a maximum stay of three months for this no-visa cohort.
Work, residence, transit, special documents, final admission and the separate third-country-document waiver are outside scope.

policies.title: Salvadoran ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's official nationality table says Salvadoran visitors can obtain a visa on arrival for 40 JOD.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Salvadoran passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The official table states a total charge of 40 JOD for the visa obtained on arrival.
Jordan's page instructs non-Jordanian visitors to register through Gateway2Jordan before departure and present the resulting QR code.
Work, study, residence, transit, restricted crossings, special documents and final admission are outside scope.
